comment: Headlines for the visual guard only, written by hand in the shape scripts/news.ts produces. Dates sit around the frozen clock of scripts/visual.mjs (2026-08-04 12:00 +02:00) so every group falls inside its own window; generatedAt is stamped by the runner. Titles are invented, at the lengths the real feeds produce — one over 120 characters, so the panel's two-line clamp and the card's truncation are both guarded.
